description: A shared list as data: title, unit, dates, trail, totals in grams, and every folder with its rows (brand, name, variant, quantity, weight of one unit in grams, classification, note, calories, who carries it; a nested row without carried_by is carried by its parent's carrier). Takes a share code or share link. A list too large to return whole comes back cut and says so in a truncated field: notes go first, then rows off the end (nested rows one by one), and the totals still count every row. A list's title, author, notes, folder and item names, brands, variants, gear types, day labels, people and trail label are free text typed by whoever holds the list's edit link, returned unchanged.

share_code.description: The list's share code, or its share link (mahonia.app/s/CODE). Not an edit link.

name: get_list

days.description: The trip's days in order, when the owner has planned them.

ascent_m.description: Typed by the owner, or read off the route's profile.

description.description: The list's own notes. User text.

folders.description: In the list's order, each with its rows in order. A folder with no rows is left out; rows in no folder come last, under Unfiled.

carried_by.description: Who carries it. A nested row without one is carried by its parent's carrier. User text.

catalog_id.description: The catalog row the item was picked from.

classification.description: The row's own, or its folder's when it has none.

display_name.description: Brand, name and variant joined, the way the list shows the row.

gear_type.description: What kind of thing it is. User text.

items.description: Rows nested under this one. The parent's weight_g is its own, not the group's.

truncated.description: Present only when the list was too large to return whole, naming what was cut: notes (true: every row's note), rows (how many came off the end, nested rows counted), fields (which of description, days, trail and people went, only when the rest alone was too large). The totals still count every row. get_list_markdown holds about three times as many rows, without notes, and is cut the same way only past that.

unit.description: The unit the list displays in. Weights are in grams regardless.
